assumptions: Repeat the October 8 through 14 event mix for 30 days; scenario, not account forecast.
Prepared desktop replaces the old separate container build and GitHub-runner desktop suite; source snapshot rebuilt once per selected desktop revision, one fresh consumer follows.
Cancellation immediately stops all stages in the superseded workload. A consumer starts only after preparation finishes; no cancellation lag, startup minima, or queue delay.
Core feature matrix replaces prior core-only baseline. Browser jobs add to retained logger types/unit job. Android host and cloud APK creation retained; Android device execution remains local.
Browser environment refresh charged separately at illustrative frequencies. Initial base Node/dependency image preparation and reusable desktop base package image refresh are unpriced.
Known passing-result subtotal assumes uploading named completed suites, excludes other suites and duplicate uploads, and is not account total. No partial cancelled-stage results assumed.
Standalone sandbox sensitivity uses the entire observed session including idle and downloads. Billing-pool allocation unverified; do not deduct CI allowance or assert invoice amount.
Developer subtotals assume paid overage allowed. Hard-start limits can instead leave work unstarted. Daily Depot mode retains affected-push validation on GitHub.
exclusions: Other packages and consumer closure beyond selected families
Platform release smoke checks, fuzz/conformance, remaining native apps
Extra retries and failed setup attempts outside measured recurring baselines
Account-wide artifact/storage scopes, taxes and complete provider invoice
Physical/device performance and local headed Android emulator resources
Production integration work and reliable admission reservation
